description: Cross-language conformance for what an OpenAPI document declares (issues #629, #715, moved engine-side by #853). The engine derives the stored `operations` index by reading the document (core/openapi_document.cpp); the renderer's import parsers stamp each request's own `specOperation` from the same bytes. Coverage matches one against the other - `OperationIndex::resolve` follows `operationId` first and `METHOD path` second - so a disagreement between the two readers does not fail loudly, it credits the wrong operation. This table is what keeps them honest: engine/tests/openapi_document_test.cpp and app/src/services/openapi/declared-operations.conformance.test.ts both read it.

readers.engine: the whole row, in document order - `declared_operations_of` produces the stored index, `responses` included
readers.app: the identity only (`operationId`, `method`, `path`), from `readSpecOperations().operations`, compared as a set: the renderer walks its own collection tree (root requests, then tag folders), so its order is the tree's rather than the document's. `responses` has no renderer reader at all any more - only the engine writes the index.

cases.name: a 3.0 document: every method under every path, in document order
status patterns verbatim - a range and `default` are their own promises
a repeated operationId is kept on its first declaration only (issue #715)
a Swagger 2.0 document, by the same rules
a path key that is not a path declares no operation - the request imports without an identity
a $ref'd path item is followed one hop - what a bundler emits when it hoists a shared one
`trace` declares nothing - Vayu has no verb for it, so no request can carry that identity
a YAML document, unquoted status keys and all
cases.document:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Pets API
paths:
  /pets/{petId}:
    get:
      operationId: getPet
      responses:
        200:
          description: ok
        404:
          description: gone
  /pets:
    post:
      operationId: createPet
      responses:
        201: { description: made }

cases.name: a YAML document that shares a response through an anchor
cases.document:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Anchored
components:
  responses:
    NotFound: &notFound
      description: Not found
paths:
  /pets/{petId}:
    get:
      operationId: getPet
      responses:
        200:
          description: ok
        404: *notFound
